text:
maria_cs: Heads up — weekly Private/VPC health check (region-by-region). Posting quick snapshot, please flag anything I missed. TL;DR: us-west-2 minor KMS decrypt errors early Tue; eu-west-1 had transient tail latency during deployment; ap-southeast-1 steady. See stats below.

aj_engineer: Can you paste the error logs for the KMS decrypt errors? svc logs showed 502? @liam_infra

maria_cs: Here are quick snippets: ```ERROR 2026-03-16T02:13:04Z request_id=abc123 KMSDecryptFailed key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:... error=AccessDenied``` Happened 02:13–02:18 UTC, ~120 requests failed, retries recovered.

liam_infra: Looks like key policy change during rotation window. I opened infra ticket INF-5487 to coordinate with customer's KMS admin. Also found 1 failed connection to customer's HSM in the same window: TLS handshake timeout.

sophia_csm: Customer (Orchid Corp) reported ~15m app errors, were they on Dedicated or Private? I told them we were investigating.

maria_cs: They're on Private (VPC, us-west-2). We've already applied fallback to hosted model for critical requests — fallback rate ~0.6% for that period.

kms-rotation-bot: Scheduled rotation for key alias/redwood/private/usw2 completed at 2026-03-16T01:59Z — no automated failures detected.

liam_infra: Rotation bot shows completion, but I suspect IAM deny due to conditional that disallows service principal from this subnet. Need customer's side to add condition exception. I'll DM their admin.

aj_engineer: Latency note: eu-west-1 spike correlated with a deploy at 03:40 UTC — p95 jumped from 120ms to 560ms for ~10min. Rolling deploy triggered cache warmup—no errors, just tail latency. Logged under PERF-332.

sophia_csm: Renewal risk? Customer raised incident and asked about SLA credit. They want a postmortem and proof the KMS/HSM settings won't repeat.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) liam: follow up on key policy + HSM TLS issue with customer by EOD. 2) aj: add runbook note on fallback config and fallback metrics. 3) sophia: schedule postmortem call and share draft RCA template. 4) ops: set alert to trigger when KMSDecryptFailed > 50 in 5m.

liam_infra: Will do. Also requesting customer's HSM vendor logs — asked for syslog export.

aj_engineer: I'll add the runbook snippet: ```if KMSDecryptFailed > 50 in 5m then route-critical->hosted, notify #eng-oncall, open ticket PERF/KMS```

sophia_csm: I'll propose a bill credit threshold and send renewal-facing comms draft by tomorrow. Also capture feedback: customer asked for guided checklist for KMS rotations.

maria_cs: Thanks. One more data point: spend was stable; small uptick due to retries during window (~$120 extra over the week). Uptime by region: us-west-2 99.95% (downtime ~20m), eu-west-1 99.99%, ap-southeast-1 100%.

aj_engineer: :thumbsup: I'll push alerts and the runbook PR now.

kms-health-monitor: Detected new policy anomaly in us-west-2 on 2026-03-16T02:10Z — flagged for manual review.

sophia_csm: Copy. I'll loop in sales if renewal chatter escalates. Thanks everyone.

maria_cs: :white_check_mark: Closing the weekly snapshot. I'll update the ticket INF-5487 with notes and next steps.
